main.description: A checkout. Lives in the borrower's repo and exists only while the item is out: check-in deletes it (and writes a return receipt). The library finds open loans by their backlink to its DID, so anyone with an atproto account can borrow. The owner can close a loan they can't delete with a checkin record.

subject.description: The item record in the library owner's repo.

library.description: The library owner's DID. This is the backlink the library looks up.
